cv.name: Kavya Chandran
cv.headline: Assistant Construction Manager | Mid-rise residential and modular builds
cv.summary: Civil engineering graduate with four years on site across wood-frame residential and modular projects. Returned to construction in 2024 after a two-year career break for family care; used the time to finish Gold Seal coursework at BCIT.

experience.title: Assistant Construction Manager

Run weekly subcontractor meetings and track RFIs and submittals in Procore
Prepared three-week look-ahead schedules; crane idle time cut by about 20%
Support the superintendent with site safety orientations and toolbox talks

experience.title: Field Engineer
bullets: Layout checks, quantity take-offs and daily reports for two townhouse developments
Managed deficiency lists through occupancy for 54 units

experience.title: Engineering Co-op Student
bullets: Assisted with grading and underground servicing inspections

education.degree: Bachelor of Applied Science, Civil Engineering
